reading: Bangkok roads were submerged by floodwaters.
A flood emergency disaster was declared across Bangkok.
More than 300mm of rain fell since Thursday.
The heavy rains have subsided, but the flooding is not yet over.
Water levels in canals remain high.
People were urged to stay at home.
More heavy rain is forecast through the week.
